title: 💬  To optimize the system's performance, arrange the symbols as follows: DABC. This arrangement satisfies all performance rules and results in the best possible outcome.

messages.content:
## Instructions
Arrange the symbols in the optimal order.

### System

The system relies on a unique set of four symbols, and it is only valid when all symbols are used exactly once. The order of symbols determines the system's performance.

### Symbols and Performance

| Symbol | Performance Rule |
| ------ | ---------------- |
| A | Best performance when not followed by more than one symbol. |
| B | Best performance when not preceded by symbol A or C. |
| C | Best performance when it is not the last symbol. |
| D | Best performance when it is the first symbol. |

The challenge is to arrange these symbols (A, B, C, D) in a sequence that maximizes their performance based on the given rules.

Here is the arrangement of symbols that would maximize their performance:

D - A - B - C

Explanation:
1. According to the rule for symbol D, its best performance is achieved when it is the first symbol.
2. For symbol A, it performs best when not followed by more than one symbol. Placing it second ensures this condition holds true as there will be no other symbols after A.
3. Moving on to symbol B, it has the highest potential if not preceded by symbol A or C. Since we have already placed A before B, placing any other symbol before B becomes impossible without violating another rule or duplicating symbols. Hence, positioning B third satisfies both conditions since neither A nor C comes before it.
4. Lastly, symbol C should ideally not be the last symbol, so putting it at the end meets this requirement while also adhering to the previous decisions regarding the placement of symbols A, B, and D.
